visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-bleed image-only slides, no text overlay, dot indicators below, prev/next buttons.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed image slideshow with prev/next buttons and dot indicators; text overlay optional.

contentPattern.summary: Interactive rotating slideshow of 5 full-width images with dot indicators.
contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 image (required), cell 2 optional text (heading, description, CTA link)

cells: text content (optional: heading, description, CTA) - empty on this page

occurrences.reason: Interactive rotating slideshow of 5 full-width images with dot indicators.

usage: Full-bleed rotating image slideshow at the top of a page. One row per slide: image cell, optional text cell (heading, description, CTA). Prev/next buttons and dot indicators appear when there are 2+ slides.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width hero slideshows, with or without overlay text. For a single static hero image use hero instead.
